title: QMC-Net: Data-Aware Quantum Representations for Remote Sensing Image Classification
summary: Hybrid quantum-classical models offer a promising route for learning from complex data; however, their application to multi-band remote sensing imagery often relies on generic, data-agnostic quantum circuits that fail to account for channel-specific statistical variability. In this work, we propose a data-driven framework that maps band-level statistics such as Shannon Entropy, Variance, Spectral Flatness, and Edge Density to the hyperparameters of customized quantum circuits.
